προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρώτοισι: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the foremost’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’for the wives’)
πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
πυκινὸν: πυκινός — thick, close-set, solid; masc. acc. sg.: ’solid’ · also masc. acc. sg., of a plot: ’close-woven, cunning’ (πυκινὸν δόλον ’a cunning trap’) · also neut. acc. sg., of a word: ’shrewd’ (πυκινὸν ἔπος ’a shrewd word’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with νέφος: ’dense’ (πυκινὸν νέφος ’dense cloud’)
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’much, greatly’ (πόλλ’ ἀεκαζομένη ’much against her will’)
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’)
σιωπῇ: σιωπή — silence; fem. dat. sg., dative of manner: ’in silence’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
σχέτλιος: σχέτλιος — cruel, ruthless, hard-hearted; masc. nom. sg., of a person or god
σὲ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀνῆκεν: ’you’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τάδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (τάδ’ = τάδε): ’these things’ · also with a noun: ’these’ (τάδ’ ἔργα)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέκμωρ: τέκμωρ — a fixed mark, sign, pledge; neut. nom. sg. (indecl.) · also goal, end, issue (τέκμωρ Ἰλίου ’the end of Ilios’)
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. acc. sg. · also relative, ’whom, which’; accented before an enclitic · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that’ (τήν γε μάχην ’that battle’)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’)
ταύτης: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with γενεῆς: ’of this’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεθαρσήκασι: θαρσέω — be bold, take heart; perf. 3 pl.: ’have taken heart’
τελαμώνιε: Τελαμώνιος — Telamonian, of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. voc. sg., of Ajax
τελευτὴ: τελευτή — end, fulfilment, death; fem. nom. sg.: βιότοιο τελευτή ’the end of life’
τετιηότες: τετιηώς — grieved, dejected (perf. part. with present sense; the verb is not otherwise found); masc. nom. pl.
τετιμῆσθαι: τιμάω — honour, value; perf. pass. inf.: ’to be honoured’
τιμῆς: τιμή — honour, worth; fem. gen. sg., partitive after ἔμμορε
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. τοί (= Attic οἱ), used as a relative: ’who’ · also τοί = τοι, encl. dat. of σύ: ’to you’ (κασίγνητος δέ τοί εἰμι ’I am your brother’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’)
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’) · also fem. gen. sg., of the person heard after ἔκλυεν: ’her’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’)
τῇσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ταῖς): ’for them’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’dear’ (φίλα τέκνα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as adverb: φίλα φρονέων ’kindly disposed’
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλτατοι: φίλος — dear; superl. φίλτατος, masc. nom. pl.: ’dearest’
φοίνικι: φοῖνιξ — crimson, purple-red (the dye); masc. dat. sg., instrumental · also Φοῖνιξ — Phoenix, one of the envoys; masc. dat. sg., indirect object of νεῦσε: ’to Phoenix’
φοῖνιξ: Φοῖνιξ — Phoenix, Achilles’ old tutor; masc. nom. sg. · also φοῖνιξ, a Phoenician; masc. nom. sg.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρονέω: φρονέω — think, have in mind, be minded; pres. 1 sg., + inf.: ’I am minded’
χάριν: χάρις — grace, favour, thanks; fem. acc. sg.: ’thanks’
χρεὼ: χρεώ — need, necessity; fem. nom. sg. (indeclinable), with ἐστί understood, + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need (for X of Y)’
χρυσέοισι: χρύσεος — golden; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic uncontracted -έοισι (= Attic χρυσοῖς), agreeing with ἱμᾶσιν
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, one must; impersonal verb + acc. and inf.
χόλον: χόλος — anger, wrath (lit. gall, bile); acc. sg.
χόλος: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. nom. sg.
χόλῳ: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. dat. sg., dative of cause: ’in anger’
ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg. · also the proper name Ἀγήνωρ — Agenor, a Trojan leader; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαθόν: ἀγαθός — good; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παῖδ’ (βίην acc. of respect: ’good in strength’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun: ’(for) good’ (εἰς ἀγαθόν ’for good’)
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγασσάμενοι: ἀγάομαι (ἄγαμαι) — wonder at, be indignant at, resent; aor. part. mid. dep. masc. nom. pl., epic double σ (ἀγασσάμενοι)
ἀγγελίην: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. acc. sg.
ἀκὴν: ἀκήν — silent, in silence; adv. (frozen acc. of ἀκή), predicative: ’still, silent’
ἀλεξέμεναι: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend; inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀλέξειν): ’to defend’
ἀλκή: ἀλκή — defence, strength to resist, might; fem. nom. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφιελίσσας: ἀμφιέλισσα — curved at both ends (standing epithet of ships); fem. acc. pl.
ἀμφικύπελλον: ἀμφικύπελλος — meaning disputed: usually ’double’ (a cup with a bowl at each end), also ’two-handled’; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δέπας

ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj. of two endings, acc. sg. (masc./fem.) · also neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; fem. dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., paired with ἐποτρύνει: ’bids’
ἀνώγῃ: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with pres. sense); subj. 3 sg., after ὅτ’ ἄν: ’may bid’
ἀπέειπε: ἀπεῖπον — say out, deliver (a message), tell out; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπεῖπε)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀποπλείειν: ἀποπλέω — sail away, sail off; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀποπλεῖν)
ἀπόφασθε: ἀποφημί — say out, declare, report; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.
ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀτρεΐδαο: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus, i.e. Agamemnon; gen. sg., epic (-αο = Attic -ου) · also son of Atreus, i.e. Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀτρεΐδῃ: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic, of Agamemnon); masc. dat. sg.
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχεύων: ἀχεύω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic by-form of ἀχέω: ’grieving’
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄγεθ: ἄγω — lead, bring; imper. 2 pl., elided (ἄγεθ’ = ἄγετε), as an interjection: ’come now!’
ἄγριον: ἄγριος — wild, savage; adj., acc. sg., with αἶγα · also masc. acc. sg., with αἰχμητήν: ’wild (spearman)’
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg.: ’another thing’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an unexpressed verb: ’else’ (οὐ … ἄλλο ’nothing else’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with an understood πῦρ: ’the other’
ἄλλοθεν: ἄλλοθεν — from elsewhere, from another place; adv. (ἄλλος + -θεν ’from’)
ἄλλοισιν: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄνεῳ: ἄνεως — silent, speechless; masc. nom. pl.
ἄνωγεν: ἄνωγα — order, bid; perf. with present force, 3 sg. ἄνωγεν also in past sense (= ἠνώγει): ’ordered’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐάσομεν: ἐάω — let, allow; fut. 1 pl. act. + acc. and inf.: ’we will allow (him) to’
ἐΰζωνος: εὔζωνος — well-girdled; fem. nom. sg. (2-term.), epic ἐΰ-
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’ · also ’came to be, got (on one’s way)’ (πρὸ ὁδοῦ ἐγένοντο ’got well on the road’) · also aor. 3 pl. with a predicate: ’became, fell’ (ἀκὴν ἐγένοντο ’fell silent’)
ἐθέλει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 3 sg.
ἐθέλῃσιν: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἐθέλῃ), after αἴ κεν
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέλευσε: κελεύω — bid, order, command; aor. 3 sg., + acc. + inf.
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐμῇ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. dat. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)

ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’)
ἐπί: ἐπί — on, upon, towards; prep. + dat./acc./gen., accented before the enclitic τε; ἐπί τε … καί ’both to … and’ · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπί τ’ … ἠμύει ’bows down upon’)
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain)
ἐπῄνησαν: ἐπαινέω — approve, agree; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’approved’
ἐρέοντο: ἐρέομαι — ask, enquire; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἠρέοντο)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐτίομεν: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 1 pl. act.: ’we were honouring’
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’)
ἐχέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep in check; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἔχειν): ’to hold’
ἐϋσσέλμους: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched (of ships); adj. of two endings, acc. pl., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἑθεν: οὗ (ἕ) — of him, her, itself; 3rd-person pron., gen. sg., epic ἕθεν (= Attic οὗ): ’her’, after εἵνεκα: ’for her sake’ · also gen. sg. with the preverb of ὑπερέσχε: ’over it’ (ἑθεν … χεῖρα ὑπερέσχε ’held his hand over it’)
ἑλκέμεν: ἕλκω — drag, haul; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἕλκειν)
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἑὴν: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-person possessive adj., fem. acc. sg. ἑήν; not the relative
ἔβαν: βαίνω — go; aor. 3 pl., epic ἔβαν (= Attic ἔβησαν)
ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔνθεο: ἐντίθημι — put in, place in; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic ἔνθου)
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί)
ἔξοχον: ἔξοχος — standing out, eminent; adj., masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέμενος, + gen. of comparison: ’choice beyond (others)’
ἔρεξεν: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; aor. 3 sg.: ’did’
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
ἕαται: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. 3 pl., epic ἕαται (= Attic κάθηνται): ’sit’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἵλοντο): ’took (for themselves)’
ἕπηται: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause
ἕποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented (ἕποντο = εἵποντο)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠοῖ: ἠώς — dawn; fem. dat. sg. (= Attic ἕῳ): ’at dawn’
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; fem. acc. sg., with ὑπό: ’beneath the dawn’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ τ’ ἠέλιόν τε ’under dawn and sun’) · also fem. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’Dawn’ (Ἠῶ δῖαν φανήμεναι ’that heavenly Dawn appear’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of μίμνω: ’Dawn’ (Ἠῶ μίμνον ’waited for Dawn’)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἢν: ἐάν (ἤν) — if (= εἰ + ἄν); conj. + subj.; ἢν μή ’unless’
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’)
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥμισυ: ἥμισυς — half; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’half’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’led, brought’
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν) · also + gen. of what is begun: ’began, led off’ (μύθων ἦρχε ’led off the talk’) · also + dat. of the troops led: ’led’ (ἦρχε … σφιν ’led them’)
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’)
ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. sg.: ’equal’, or adverbial ’equally’ · also masc. acc. sg., + dat.: ’equal (to)’ (ὃν ἶσον ἐτίομεν ’whom we honoured as equal’)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀδυσεῦ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., single-σ form (Attic Ὀδυσσεῦ)
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀτρύνων: ὀτρύνω — urge on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’urging’
ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
ὁδῷ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. dat. sg.
ὁππότε: ὁππότε — when; temporal conj., epic doubled π (= ὁπότε)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’)
ὄφελες: ὀφείλω — owe, ought; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (ὄφελες = ὤφελες) with an inf. in a wish: ’would that you had’
ὄφρά: ὄφρα — so that, until, while; conj., epic (= Attic ἵνα, ἕως); with the subj.: ’so that’ (accent from the following enclitic)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’)
ὅππως: ὅππως — how, in what way; epic doubled π (= ὅπως), introducing an indirect question
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
ὑπερέσχε: ὑπερέχω — hold over, rise above; aor. 3 sg.: ’held over’
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’)
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., epithet of Dawn
